code.grouping: aadistill.data.sessions.pack_sessions groups by system_group_key (the rendered system text and tool schemas) and by nothing else; pack_group fills each sequence in the given order
code.category_and_source: read only to ORDER sessions (mixture.interleave) and sequences (mixture.order_blocks) and to record them in the audit; neither is a packing boundary
code.same_conversation: a unit's turns never share a sequence (source_id deferral): one turn would read another's answer

joint_repacking.what: re-packing E1's default-system-prompt sessions together with the fluid increment
joint_repacking.the_only_shareable_group: E1's default system prompt is the fluid data's ('You are a helpful Assistant.'): E1's tool-calling sequences carry their own tool schemas and can share with nothing
joint_repacking._bound: every fluid padding position filled by E1 tokens; E1's default sequences are already this full, so the real saving is smaller
joint_repacking.scientific_cost: D4-Augmented's E1 part would stop being E1's pack: E1 sessions re-placed, their truncation re-decided (or removed), so D4-Augmented no longer equals D4-Original's training data plus an increment and Comparison B loses its clean attribution; PCA-Original and D4-Original keep E1's pack either way
joint_repacking.recommendation: keep the two-part layout; the bound is too small to pay that cost

train_validation: every arm validates on E1's 16 sequences; the fluid tokens past the 2.96M cut are never trained, and any later fluid validation drawn from them excludes every unit with a turn inside the cut
